- _Pending Approval_ : The cost projection has been taken off hold and is awaiting ap-     proval.     This status is available if the approval map has been specified in the **Cost Projec-**     **tion by Date Approval Map** box on the **Approval** tab of the _Projects Preferences_     (PO101000) form. 

- _Rejected_ : The employee who was assigned to approve the cost projection has rejected     it.     This status is available if an approval map has been specified in the **Cost Projection**     **by Date Approval Map** box on the **Approval** tab of the _Projects Preferences_ form. 

- _Open_ : The employee who was assigned to approve the cost projection has approved     it. If no approval is configured for cost projections, the system assigns this status to     the cost projection when **Remove Hold** is clicked on the form toolbar. 

- _Released_ : The cost projection has been released. 

**Date** The date when the cost projection was created. By default, the system inserts the current business date. 

**Projection Date** The date that the system uses for the calculation of the projected values in the cost projection. By default, the system inserts the current business date. 

**Description** A brief description of the cost projection. 

**Budget Level** section 

**Project Task** A check box that indicates (if selected) that the cost projection includes the cost task level of detail. The check box is selected by default in a newly created cost projection. 

**Account Group** A check box that indicates (if selected) that the cost projection includes the account group level of detail. The check box is selected by default in a newly created cost projection. 

**Inventory ID** A check box that indicates (if selected) that the cost projection includes the inventory item level of detail. The check box is selected by default in a newly created cost projection if the cost budget level of the project includes inventory items. 

 This check box can be selected or cleared only if the cost budget level of the project includes inventory items. 

**Cost Code** A check box that indicates (if selected) that the cost projection includes the cost code level of detail. The check box is selected by default in a newly created cost projection if the cost budget level of the project includes cost codes. 

 This check box is shown if the Cost Code feature is enabled on the Enable/Disable Features (CS100000) form and can be selected only if the cost budget level of the project includes cost codes. 

**Calculation Settings** section 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1133 

**Element Description** 

**Include Pending CO in Calculations** 

 A check box that indicates (if selected) that the system includes the unreleased change order amounts when calculating the Revised Cost Budget , Revised Revenue Budget , and Open Commitments amounts of the current cost projection. 

 The system copies the default state of the check box from the Include Pending CO in Cost Projections by Date check box on the Projects Preferences (PM101000) form. 

 The check box appears if the Change Order Workflow check box is selected for the corresponding project on the Summary tab of the Projects (PM301000) form. 

**Update Project Budget** 

 A check box that indicates (if selected) that the system will update the Projected Quantity to Complete , Projected Quantity at Completion , Projected Cost to Complete , Projected Cost at Completion , and Completed (%) values of the specified project on release of this cost projection. These values will be updated on the Cost Budget tab of the Projects (PM301000) form. 

 You can select this check box only if the structure of the cost projection matches the structure of the cost budget of the corresponding project. 

 If the check box is cleared, the system does not update any values in the project on release of the cost projection. In this case, you can assign the released cost projection the On Hold status and continue editing it. 

**Summary** section 

**Revised Budget Revenue** 

 The total revised amount of the revenue budget lines of the project, which the system calculates by using the following formula. 

 SUM Original Budgeted Amount + SUM of Revenue Budget Change Total 

 In this formula, SUM of Revenue Budget Change Total is calculated for the closed revenue change orders that have a change date that is earlier than or same as the cost projection date. 

**Pending CO Revenue** 

 The pending amount of change orders for the revenue budget lines of a project. The system calculates this amount as the sum of the revenue change orders with the Open , On Hold , and Pending Approval status with a change date that is earlier than or same as the cost projection date. 

 The box appears if the Include Pending CO in Calculations check box is selected for the current cost projection. 

**Billed Revenue** The billed revenue amount of a project, which the system calculates as the sum of the amounts of project transactions. It includes the relevant project transactions with the _AR_ type on the _Project Transactions_ (PM304000) form that have the date that is earlier than or same as the cost projection date. 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1134 

**Element Description** 

**Revenue Budget Backlog** 

 The revised budgeted amount for the revenue lines of the project, which the system calculates depending on the state of the Include Pending CO in Calculations check box as follows: 

- If the check box is cleared, the system calculates the amount by using the following     formula. 

 Revised Budget Revenue – Billed Revenue 

- If the check box is selected, the system calculates the amount by using the following     formula. 

 Revised Budget Revenue + Pending CO Revenue – Billed Revenue 

**Expected Current Revenue** 

 The amount of the projected revenue, which the system calculates depending on the state of the Include Pending CO in Calculations check box as follows: 

- If the check box is cleared, the system calculates the amount by using the following     formula. 

 Revised Budget Revenue * Total of Completed (%) 

- If the check box is selected, the system calculates the amount by using the following     formula. 

 (Revised Budget Revenue + Pending CO Revenue) * Total of Completed (%) 

 In this formula, Total of % Completed is the sum of the amounts in the Completed (%) column on the Details tab. 

**Overbilling or Underbilling** 

 The overbilling or underbilling amount of the project, which the system calculates by subtracting the Expected Current Revenue amount from the Billed Revenue amount. 

**Projected Margin** The amount of the projected margin, which the system calculates depending on the state of the **Include Pending CO in Calculations** check box as follows: 

- If the check box is cleared, the system calculates the amount by using the following     formula. 

 Revised Budget Revenue + Pending CO Revenue – Total of Projected Cost at Completion 

- If the check box is selected, the system calculates the amount by using the following     formula. 

 Revised Budget Revenue – Total of Projected Cost at Completion 

 In this formula, Total of Projected Cost at Completion is the sum of the amounts in the Projected Cost at Completion column on the Details tab. 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1135 

 Element Description 

 Projected Margin (%) 

 The percentage of the projected margin, which the system calculates depending on the state of the Include Pending CO in Calculations check box as follows: 

- If the check box is cleared, the system calculates the value by using the following for-     mula. 

 Projected Margin / (Revised Budget Revenue + Pending CO Revenue) 

- If the check box is selected, the system calculates the value by using the following for-     mula. 

 Projected Margin / Revised Budget Revenue + Pending CO Revenue 

 If Revised Budget Revenue is 0 , Projected Margin (%) is also set to 0.

 Construction Forms | 1136 

**Column Description** 

**Inventory ID** The stock or non-stock inventory item that is associated with the cost budget line, or the empty item code that is specified on the _Projects Preferences_ (PM101000) form. 

 This column appears if the Inventory ID check box is selected in the Summary area. 

**Projected Cost to Complete** 

 The line's projected remainder of the budgeted cost, which is calculated by subtracting the line's actual cost to date from its projected cost at completion. 

**Projected Cost at Completion** 

 The line's projected final cost on project completion. The system calculates this cost depending on the state of the Include Pending CO in Calculations check box as follows: 

- If the check box is cleared, the system calculates the amount by using the following     formula. 

 MAX of ((Revised Budgeted Cost + Pending CO Cost) or Anticipated Cost) 

- If the check box is selected, the system calculates the amount by using the following     formula. 

 MAX of ((Revised Budgeted Cost) + Pending CO Cost) or Anticipated Cost) 

 In this formula, MAX means that the system calculates the amounts and uses the maximum one. 

 If you change the Projected Cost to Complete in the line, the system recalculates this amount by using the following formula. 

 Projected Cost to Complete + Actual Cost to Date 

 If you change the Completed (%) in the line, the system recalculates this amount by using the following formula. 

 Actual Cost to Date / Completed (%) 

 Suppose that you create a new cost projection for the same project with the same budget level, load the budget lines, and click Copy Projection on the form toolbar; then you select the released cost projection to be copied. The system copies the projected cost at completion if the line's anticipated cost is less than or the same as the projected cost at completion being copied. 

**Completed (%)** The projected percentage of completion for the cost budget line, which is calculated by using the following formula. 

 Actual Cost to Date / Projected Cost at Completion 

 If Projected Cost at Completion is 0 , Completed (%) is also set to 0. 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1137 

**Column Description** 

**Revised Budgeted Cost** 

 The revised budgeted amount of the cost budget line, which the system calculates depending on the state of the Change Order Workflow check box on the Summary tab of the Projects (PM301000) form as follows: 

- If the check box is cleared, the system calculates the amount as the sum of the revised     budgeted amounts of the cost budget lines. 

- If the check box is selected, the system calculates the amount by using the following     formula. 

 SUM of Original Budgeted Amount + SUM of Cost Budget Change Total 

 In this formula, SUM of Original Budgeted Amount is the sum of the revised budgeted amounts of the cost budget lines. The SUM of Revenue Budget Change Total is calculated for the released cost change orders with a change date that is earlier than or same as the cost projection date. 

**Pending CO Cost** The pending amount of the unreleased change orders for the cost budget lines of a project. The system performs these calculations on cost change orders with the _Open_ , _On Hold_ , and _Pending Approval_ status that have a change date earlier than or the same as the projection date. 

 The column appears if the Include Pending CO in Calculations check box is selected for the current cost projection. 

**Actual Cost to Date** The line's total amount of released cost transactions. The system performs these calculations on expense project transactions that have a date earlier than or the same as the projection date. 

 The amount is calculated in the project currency. 

**Open Commitments** 

 The line's total amount of released project commitments. The system performs these calculations on only the purchase orders and subcontracts that have a document date earlier than or the same as the projection date. 

 The amount is calculated in the project currency. 

**Pending CO Commitments** 

 The pending amount of change orders to the project commitments. The system calculates the amount as the sum of the commitment change totals in change orders. The total includes change orders to commitments with the Open , On Hold , and Pending Approval status that have a change date earlier than or the same as the projection date. 

 The column appears if the Include Pending CO in Calculations check box is selected for the current cost projection. 

**Anticipated Cost** The anticipated cost of the cost budget line, which the system calculates depending on the state of the **Include Pending CO in Calculations** check box as follows: 

- If the check box is cleared, the system calculates the cost by using the following for-     mula. 

 Actual Cost to Date + Open Commitments 

- If the check box is selected, the system calculates the value by using the following for-     mula. 

 Actual Cost to Date + Open Commitments + Pending CO Commitments 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1138 

 Column Description 

 Cost Budget Backlog 

 The amount of the revised budgeted costs that is available for the project, which the system calculates depending on the state of the Include Pending CO in Calculations check box as follows: 

- If the check box is cleared, the system calculates the amount by using the following     formula. 

 Revised Budgeted Cost Actual Cost to Date 

- If the check box is selected, the system calculates the amount by using the following     formula. 

 Revised Budgeted Cost + Pending CO Cost Actual Cost to Date 

 Performance (%) The actual performance percentage of the project, which the system calculates depending on the state of the Include Pending CO in Calculations check box as follows: 

- If the check box is cleared, the system calculates the value by using the following for-     mula. 

 Actual Cost to Date / Revised Budgeted Cost 

- If the check box is selected, the system calculates the value by using the following for-     mula. 

 Actual Cost to Date / (Revised Budgeted Cost + Pending CO Cost) 

 Anticipated Performance (%) 

 The percentage of the projected performance, which the system calculates depending on the state of the Include Pending CO in Calculations check box as follows: 

- If the check box is cleared, the system calculates the value by using the following for-     mula. 

 Anticipated Cost / (Revised Budgeted Cost + Pending CO Cost) 

- If the check box is selected, the system calculates the value by using the following for-     mula. 

 Anticipated Cost / Revised Budgeted Cost

### Reassign Approval Dialog Box 

 In this dialog box, you can specify the new approver to whom you want to reassign the selected record or records. The dialog box opens when you click Reassign. 

 Element Description 

 New Approver The name of the employee to whom you want to reassign the selected record or records. 

 Ignore Approver's Delegations 

 A check box that indicates (if selected) that the system will assign the selected records to the specified new approver but not to their delegate, even if the new approver is unavailable and has a delegate specified for the current business date. 

 If the check box is cleared and if the new approver is not available and has a delegate specified for the current date, the system will reassign the selected records to the delegate if they’re available. If the delegate is unavailable, the system will reassign the requests to the delegate of the delegate. The system will continue the search in this way until: 

- It assigns an approver with no active delegations set up for the current date. 

- It detects a loop in the chain of delegations. In this case, the system will prompt you to     specify a different approver. 

 This dialog box has the following buttons. 

 Reassign Closes the dialog box and reassigns the selected record or records to the specified new approver if the reassignment of approvals is allowed in the related rule of the approval map on the Approval Maps (EP205015) form. 

 Cancel Closes the dialog box and cancels the reassignment of the selected record or records to the new approver. 

### Summary Area 

 In this area, you can enter the settings of a new daily field report, or select an existing daily field report for editing and possible modification. The following table summarizes the elements of this area.

 Construction Forms | 1145 

**Element Description** 

**DFR ID** The reference number of the daily field report, which the system automatically assigns according to the numbering sequence selected for daily field reports on the _Project Management Preferences_ (PJ101000) form. 

**Status** The status of the daily field report. 

 The status can be one of the following: 

- _On Hold_ : The daily field report is being edited. This status is automatically assigned to     a new daily field report. 

- _Pending Approval_ : The approval is needed for the daily field report. This status is as-     signed to the daily field report when **Complete** is clicked on the form toolbar if the ap-     proval workflow is configured for daily field reports (that is, an approval map is speci-     fied in the **DFR Approval Map** box of the _Project Management Preferences_ (PJ101000)     form). 

- _Rejected_ : The daily field report has been rejected. The system assigns this status to the     daily field report if the employee assigned to approve the daily field report has reject-     ed it.     This status is available if an approval map is specified in the **DFR Approval Map** box of     the _Project Management Preferences_ (PJ101000) form. 

- _Completed_ : The daily field report has been completed. This status is assigned to the     daily field report when **Completed** is clicked on the form toolbar and. If the approval     workflow has been configured, the status is assigned when all the responsible em-     ployees have approved the daily field report.

 Construction Forms | 1150 

**_Table: Table Columns_** 

 Column Description 

 Worksheet Nbr. The reference number of the progress worksheet linked to the currently selected daily field report. 

 Status The current status of the progress worksheet linked to the currently selected daily field report. The status can be one of the following: On Hold , Pending Approval , Rejected , Open , or Closed. 

 Project Task The project task of the currently selected project. 

 Inventory ID The identifier of the stock or non-stock item associated with the cost budget line of the project. 

 The column is shown if Task and Item or Task, Item, and Cost Code is selected as the Cost Budget Level of the project on the Summary tab of the Projects (PM301000) form. 

 Cost Code The cost code associated with the cost budget line of the project. 

 The column is shown if the Cost Codes feature is enabled on the Enable/Disable Features form. 

 Account Group The expense account group associated with the cost budget line of the project. 

 Description The description of the cost budget line that is associated with the project, project task, account group, and cost code or inventory item. 

 UOM The unit of measure of the cost budget line. 

 Previously Completed Quantity 

 The total quantity of the released progress worksheets that were created before the current one and that are associated with the same project, project task, account group, and cost code or inventory item. 

 The quantity is calculated as the sum of the Completed Quantity values of the lines of the progress worksheets that were released earlier than or on the date specified in the current progress worksheet and that are associated with the same project, project task, account group, and cost code or inventory item. 

 Completed Quantity 

 The quantity of units that have been used since the previous progress worksheet date. 

 Prior Period Quantity 

 The quantity of the previous financial period. This quantity is calculated as the sum of the Completed Quantity values of the lines of the released progress worksheets with dates within the previous financial period that are associated with the same project, project task, account group, and cost code or inventory item. 

 Current Period Quantity 

 The quantity of the current financial period. This quantity is calculated as the sum of the Completed Quantity values of the lines of the released progress worksheets with dates within the current financial period that are associated with the same project, project task, account group, and cost code or inventory item. 

 Total Completed Quantity 

 The total quantity in the lines of the released progress worksheets that were created before the current one and that are associated with the same project, project task, account group, and cost code or inventory item. 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1151 

 Column Description 

 Completed (%), Total 

 The total completion percentage for the cost budget line, which is calculated as the Total Completed Quantity divided by the Total Budgeted Quantity. 

 Total Budgeted Quantity 

 The total budgeted quantity for the cost budget line, which is the same as the Revised Budgeted Quantity specified on the Cost Budget tab of the Projects form.

toolbar, as commands on the More menu, or in both places. These commands are listed in the following table in alphabetical order. 

 Command Description 

 Approve Changes the status of the progress worksheet from Pending Approval to Open. 

 When you click this command, the Enter Reason dialog box opens if Is Optional or Is Required is selected in the Reason for Approval box on the Rule Actions tab of the Approval Maps (EP205015) form for the map. In the dialog box, you can (if Is Optional is selected) or must (if Is Required is selected) enter the reason the document is being approved. 

 This command appears if the progress worksheet has the Pending Approval status. 

 For more information, see Approval Configuration: Approval Maps.

 Opens the Project Progress Report (PM657000) report, for which the project and date of the project worksheet were used as the report parameters. The generated report shows the current progress for the project up to the date of the current progress worksheet. 

 Reassign Opens the Reassign Approval dialog box, in which you can specify a new approver to reassign the selected record to this approver if the reassignment of approvals is allowed in the related rule of the approval map on the Approval Maps (EP205015) form.

 For more information, see Approval Configuration: Approval Maps. 

 Reject Changes the status of the progress worksheet from Pending Approval to Rejected.

In the dialog box, you can (if Is Optional is selected) or must (if Is Required is selected) enter the reason the document is being rejected. 

 This command appears if the progress worksheet has the Pending Approval status. 

 For more information, see Approval Configuration: Approval Maps. 

 Release Releases the progress worksheet.

 Remove Hold Changes the status of the progress worksheet to Open. If an approval map is selected for progress worksheets on the Projects Preferences (PM101000) form, changes the status to Pending Approval.

### Reassign Approval Dialog Box 

 In this dialog box, you can specify the new approver to whom you want to reassign the selected record or records. The dialog box opens when you click Reassign. 

 Element Description 

 New Approver The name of the employee to whom you want to reassign the selected record or records. 

 Ignore Approver's Delegations 

 A check box that indicates (if selected) that the system will assign the selected records to the specified new approver but not to their delegate, even if the new approver is unavailable and has a delegate specified for the current business date. 

 If the check box is cleared and if the new approver is not available and has a delegate specified for the current date, the system will reassign the selected records to the delegate if they’re available. If the delegate is unavailable, the system will reassign the requests to the delegate of the delegate. The system will continue the search in this way until: 

- It assigns an approver with no active delegations set up for the current date. 

- It detects a loop in the chain of delegations. In this case, the system will prompt you to     specify a different approver. 

 This dialog box has the following buttons. 

 Reassign Closes the dialog box and reassigns the selected record or records to the specified new approver if the reassignment of approvals is allowed in the related rule of the approval map on the Approval Maps (EP205015) form. 

 Cancel Closes the dialog box and cancels the reassignment of the selected record or records to the new approver.

### Approvals Tab 

 This tab displays information about the approval history of the progress worksheet. If approval is configured, the progress worksheet is automatically assigned for approval when taken off hold. Authorized users can approve or reject the progress worksheet on the current form by using the Approve or Reject command, respectively, on the More menu. They can also mass-process progress worksheets that are pending approval by using the Approvals (EP503010) form. 

 This tab is available an approval map is specified in the Progress Worksheet Approval Map box on the Approval tab of the Projects Preferences (PJ101000) form. If no map is specified in this box, progress worksheets do not require approval. 

 If the record is rejected and then returned for editing, that rejection will be listed on the tab along with the reason that was specified during the rejection process. All other rejections and approvals will be removed from the table. 

 The table toolbar includes only standard buttons. For the list of standard buttons, see Table Toolbar. 

 Column Description 

 Assignee ID The identifier of the employee who is assigned to approve the document. 

 Assigned To The name of the employee who is assigned to approve the document. 

 Workgroup The workgroup of the employee assigned to approve the document. 

 Approved By (ID) The identifier of the employee who actually approved the document. 

 Approved By The name of the employee who actually approved the document. 

 Approval Date The date of the approval. 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1193 

 Column Description 

 Status The status of the document, which can be Pending Approval , Approved , or Rejected , depending on the approval action performed. 

 Reason The reason the document has been approved or rejected (if applicable). 

## Project AP Details 

 Form ID: (PM651001) 

 This generic inquiry form is available if the Extended Financial Data Collection feature is enabled on the Enable/Disable Features (CS100000) form. 

 On this generic inquiry form, you can view the AP amounts—such as unbilled amounts, paid amounts, and unreleased retainage—for each listed document line. The system calculates these values as of the date you specify; you can also select a project and vendor to view only their document lines. 

 You can use the form to verify the AP amounts the system has calculated on the Project Cash Flow (PM651010) form. 

### Form Toolbar 

 The form toolbar includes only standard buttons. For the list of standard buttons, see Form Toolbar and More Menu. 

### Selection Area 

 In this area, you select the date through which the system shows document lines in the table. By specifying a particular project or vendor (or both), you can narrow the range of document lines listed in the table. 

 Element Description 

 Date The date through which data is displayed—that is, you’ll see document lines up to and including this date. By default, the system inserts the current business date. 

 Project The project for which you want to view the AP amounts. 

 Vendor The vendor for which you want to view the AP amounts. If you select a vendor, you’ll see data for the vendor whose items or services were purchased for the project. 

### Table 

 In the table, you can view the AP data for the selection criteria you’ve specified. You can use this information to verify the AP amounts that the system has calculated on the Project Cash Flow (PM651010) form. Each row represents a document line. 

 Below you’ll find descriptions of the columns that show information about the listed documents, their currency rates, and their calculated values, along with calculation formulas the system uses.

These columns display the     document's basic information—such as company, branch, project, project task, account     group, and cost code. If you need information about these UI elements, see their descriptions     on the document's data entry form. 

- The values are calculated in **the project currency**. The form shows values in the base, project,     and document currencies if the _Multicurrency Accounting_ and _Multicurrency Projects_ features     are enabled on the _Enable/Disable Features_ (CS100000) form.

**Vendor** The vendor specified in the subcontract, change order, purchase order, bill, or payment. 

**Retainage Document**

**Rate (Project Curr.)** The rate used to convert document amounts to the project currency. 

 The system uses the applicable rate on one of these dates: 

- The creation date for a commitment on the _Purchase Orders_ (PO301000) or _Subcon-_     _tracts_ (SC301000) form 

- The document date for a document on the _Bills and Adjustments_ (AP301000) form 

- The date of the original document for a retainage bill, debit adjustment, or credit ad-     justments 

- The original payment date for an original or voided payment on the _Payments and Ap-_     _plications_ (AR302000) form 

**Rate (Base Curr.)** The rate used to convert document amounts to the base currency of the project. 

 The system uses the applicable rate on one of these dates: 

- The creation date for a commitment on the _Purchase Orders_ (PO301000) or _Subcon-_     _tracts_ (SC301000) form 

- The document date for a document on the _Bills and Adjustments_ (AP301000) form 

- The date of the original document for a retainage bill, debit adjustment, or credit ad-     justment 

- The original payment date for an original or voided payment. 

**UOM** The unit of measure specified in the line of the purchase order, subcontract, or bill specified in this document line. 

**Committed Qty.** The committed quantity, which is either of the following: 

- The order quantity specified in the line of the released subcontract on the _Subcon-_     _tracts_ (SC301000) or purchase order on the _Purchase Orders_ (PO301000) form 

- The quantity specified on the **Commitments** tab of the released change order on the     _Change Orders_ (PM308000) form 

**Committed Unit Cost (Project Curr.)** 

 The committed unit cost, which the system calculates by using this formula: Committed Amount (Project Curr.) / Committed Qty. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Committed Unit Cost (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1196 

**Column Description** 

**Committed Amount (Project Curr.)** 

 The extended cost specified in the line of any of the following documents: 

- The released subcontract or purchase order 

- The amount specified on the **Commitments** tab of the released change order on the     _Change Orders_ (PM308000) form 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Committed Amount (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**Committed Retainage (Project Curr.)** 

 The committed retainage amount, which the system calculates by using this formula: Retainage Amount * Rate (Project Curr.). 

 Retainage Amount is the retainage amount specified on the Details tab of the Subcontracts (SC301000) form for the line. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Committed Retainage (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**Billed Qty.** The quantity of the items that have been billed on the _Bills and Adjustments_ (AP301000) form, which is one of the following: 

- For a released document of the _Bill_ or _Credit Adj._ type, it’s the quantity specified in the     document line. 

- For a released document of the _Debit Adj._ type, it’s the quantity specified in the docu-     ment line is shown as a negative value. 

**Unit Cost (Project Curr.)** 

 The cost per UOM of the inventory item specified in the line, which the system calculates by using this formula: Extended Cost (Project Curr.) / Billed Qty. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Unit Cost (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**Extended Cost** The extended cost specified in the line of the released document of the _Bill_ or _Credit Adj._ type on the _Bills and Adjustments_ (AP301000) form. For a document of the _Debit Adj._ type, the cost is shown as a negative value. 

**Extended Cost (Project Curr.)** 

 The extended cost in the project currency, which the system calculates by using this formula: Extended Cost * Rate (Project Curr.). 

 If the project currency is the same as the document’s base currency, the system shows the extended cost in the base currency. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Extended Cost (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly.

 Construction Forms | 1197 

**Column Description** 

**Billed Inclusive Tax (Project Curr.)** 

 The billed inclusive tax amount applied to the project's original AP bills, which the system proportionally spreads across the lines of the bill. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Billed Inclusive Tax (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**Billed Tax (Project Curr.)** 

 The billed exclusive tax amount applied to the project's original AP bill, which the system proportionally spreads across the lines of the bill with the tax category that requires this tax calculation. 

 For a document of the Debit Adj. type, the amount is shown as a negative value. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Billed Tax (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**AP Retained Amount (Project Curr.)** 

 The AP retainage amount, which the system calculates by using one of these formulas depending on the type of the document: 

- For an original bill, Retainage Amount * Rate (Project Curr.).     Retainage Amount is the retainage amount of each line of the bill. 

- For a retainage bill, Ext. Cost * Rate (Project Curr.) * (-1). 

- For a debit adjustment, Retainage Amount * Rate (Project Curr.) *     (-1). 

- For a retainage debit adjustment, Ext. Cost * Rate (Project Curr.).     Ext. Cost is the extended cost of each line of the retainage debit adjustment. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the AP Retained Amount (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**AP Retained Taxes (Project Curr.)** 

 The retained tax amount applied to the project's original AP bills and retainage debit adjustments, which the system proportionally spreads across the lines of the bill. 

 This amount doesn't include the use tax, whose amount you can review in the Use Tax (Project Curr.) column. 

 For a document of the Debit Adj. type or retainage bill, the amount is shown as a negative value. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the AP Retained Taxes (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**AP Amount** The sum of the amounts specified in the lines of the released bill or credit adjustment and the billed tax amount, which the system calculates in the document currency. 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1198 

**Column Description** 

**AP Amount (Project Curr.)** 

 The amount of the bill, which the system calculates by using this formula: AP Amount / Rate (Project Curr.). 

 If the project currency is the same as the document currency, this value is the same as the AP Amount. 

 If the project currency is the same as the document base currency, the system multiplies the AP Amount by the base currency rate specified on the document's data entry form. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the AP Amount (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**AP Paid Amount** The paid amount of the bill, which can be either of the following depending on the state of the **Pay by Line** check box on the _Bills and Adjustments_ (AP301000) form: 

- If the check box is cleared: The amount paid specified in the **Application History** tab     of the document on the _Checks and Payments_ (AP302000) form. The system propor-     tionally spreads this amount across the lines of the original bill. 

- If the check box is selected: The amount paid specified in the **Application History** tab     of the document on the _Checks and Payments_ (AP302000) form applied to the original     bill's line specified in **Line Nbr.** column. 

**AP Paid Amount (Project Curr.)** 

 The paid amount of the bill, which the system calculates by using this formula: AP Paid Amount * Rate (Project Curr.). 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the AP Paid Amount (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**AP Cash Discount (Project Curr.)** 

 The cash discount, which can be either of the following depending on the state of the Pay by Line check box on the Invoices and Memos (AR301000) form: 

- If the check box is cleared: The cash discount specified on the **Application History**     tab of the document on the _Checks and Payments_ (AP302000) form. The system pro-     portionally spreads this amount across the lines of the original bill and multiplies the     amount by the rate in the project currency. 

- If the check box is selected: The cash discount specified on the **Application History**     tab of the document on the _Checks and Payments_ (AP302000) form applied to the orig-     inal bill's line specified in **Line Nbr.** column and multiplied by the rate in the project     currency. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the AP Cash Discount (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly.

 Construction Forms | 1199 

**Column Description** 

**Withheld Tax Amount (Project Curr.)** 

 The withheld tax amount, which can be either of the following depending on the state of the Pay by Line check box on the Invoices and Memos (AR301000) form: 

- If the check box is cleared: The withheld tax amount specified on the **Application His-**     **tory** tab of the document on the _Checks and Payments_ (AP302000) form. The system     proportionally spreads this amount across the lines of the original bill and multiplies     the amount by the rate in the project currency. 

- If the check box is selected: The withheld tax amount specified on the **Application**     **History** tab of the document on the _Checks and Payments_ (AP302000) form applied to     the original bill's line specified in **Line Nbr.** column and multiplied by the rate in the     project currency. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Withheld Tax Amount (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**Paid Inclusive Tax (Project Curr.)** 

 The paid inclusive tax amount, which the system calculates by using this formula: (Amount Paid + Cash Discount Taken) * Billed Inclusive Tax (Project Curr.) of each paid bill line / Amount of the paid bill. 

- Amount Paid and Cash Discount are specified on the **Application History** tab     of the document on the _Checks and Payments_ (AP302000) form. 

- Amount is specified in the Summary area of the _Bills and Adjustments_ (AP301000)     form. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Paid Inclusive Tax (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**Exclusive Taxes on Paid AP (Project Curr.)** 

 The tax amount on the paid amount of the bill, which the system calculates by using this formula: (Amount Paid + Cash Discount Taken) * Billed Tax (Project Curr.) of each paid bill line / Amount of the paid bill. 

- Amount Paid and Cash Discount Taken are specified on the **Application His-**     **tory** tab of the document on the _Checks and Payments_ (AP302000) form. 

- Amount is specified in the Summary area of the _Bills and Adjustments_ (AP301000)     form. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Exclusive Taxes on Paid AP (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1200 

 Column Description 

 Use Tax (Project Curr.) 

 The billed use tax amount applied to the project's original AP bills, which the system proportionally spreads across the lines of the bill. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Use Tax (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

 Realized Gain/Loss (Project Curr.) 

 The realized gain or loss, which the system calculates by using this formula: AP Paid Amount * Rate (Project Curr.) on the original bill's date Rate (Project Curr.) on the payment date. 

 If the project currency is the same as the bill's currency, the realized gain or loss is 0. 

 If the project currency is the same as the bill's base currency, the realized gain or loss is the same as the one specified in the GL transaction. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Realized Gain/Loss (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly.

- If the check box is selected: The discount specified on the **Application History** tab     of the _Payments and Applications_ (AR302000) form applied directly to the invoice line     specified in the **Line Nbr.** column and multiplied by the **Rate (Project Curr.)** 

- If the check box is cleared: The amount specified on the **Application History** tab of     the _Payments and Applications_ (AR302000) form distributed among the original invoice     lines in proportion to the **AR Amount** and multiplied by the **Rate (Project Curr.)** 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the AR Cash Discount (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**Write-Off Amount (Project Curr.)** 

 The write-off amount, which can be either of the following, depending on the state of the Pay by Line check box on the Invoices and Memos (AR301000) form: 

- If the check box is selected: The write-off amount specified on the **Application His-**     **tory** tab of the _Payments and Applications_ (AR302000) form applied to the invoice line     specified in the **Line Nbr.** column and multiplied by the **Rate (Project Curr.)** 

- If the check box is cleared: The write-off amount specified on the **Application Histo-**     **ry** tab of the _Payments and Applications_ (AR302000) form distributed among the origi-     nal invoice lines in proportion to the **AR Amount** and multiplied by the **Rate (Project**     **Curr.)** 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Write-Off Amount (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1206 

 Column Description 

 Paid Inclusive Tax (Project Curr.) 

 The paid inclusive tax amount, which the system calculates by using this formula: (Amount Paid + Cash Discount Taken) * Inclusive Taxes on AR (Project Curr.) of each paid AR invoice line / Amount of the paid invoice. 

- Amount Paid and Cash Discount are specified on the **Application History** tab     of the document on the _Payments and Applications_ (AR302000) form. 

- Amount is specified in the Summary area of the _Invoices and Memos_ (AR301000) form. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Paid Inclusive Tax (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

 Exclusive Taxes on Paid AR (Project Curr.) 

 The tax amount on the paid amount of the invoice, which the system calculates by using this formula: (Amount Paid + Cash Discount Taken) * Exclusive Taxes on AR (Project Curr.) of each paid invoice line / Amount of the paid invoice. 

- Amount Paid and Cash Discount Taken are specified on the **Application His-**     **tory** tab of the document on the _Payments and Applications_ (AR302000) form. 

- Amount is specified in the Summary area of the _Invoices and Memos_ (AR301000)     (AP301000) form. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Exclusive Taxes on Paid AR (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

 Realized Gain/Loss (Project Curr.) 

 The realized gain or loss, which the system calculates by using this formula: AR Paid Amount * Rate (Project Curr.) on the original invoice's date 

- Rate (Project Curr.) on the payment date. 

 If the project currency is the same as the AR invoice's currency, the realized gain or loss is 0. 

 If the project currency is the same as the AR invoice's base currency, the realized gain or loss is the same as the one specified in the GL transaction. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Realized Gain/Loss (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

## Project Cash Flow 

 Form ID: (PM651010) 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1207 

 This generic inquiry form is available if the Extended Financial Data Collection feature is enabled on the Enable/Disable Features (CS100000) form. 

 This generic inquiry form provides visibility into your project's cash flow as of the date you specify. You can identify potential shortfalls or surplus funds and ensure that each project has enough cash to cover its expenses. 

 Initially, the form shows projects with all statuses, but you can filter the data in the table to show projects with any status. 

### Form Toolbar 

 The form toolbar includes only standard buttons. For the list of standard buttons, see Form Toolbar and More Menu. 

### Selection Area 

 In this area, you select the date through which the system shows projects in the table. 

 Element Description 

 Date The date through which the data is displayed—that is, you’ll see project data up to and including this date. By default, the system inserts the current business date. 

### Table 

 In the table, you can view each project’s date-specific cash flow, revenue budget backlog, and cost budget backlog. You can also see the total amounts across all listed projects. Each row represents a project. 

 Below you can find information about the columns that contain the project’s calculated values, along with the formulas that the system uses for these calculations. 

- The lemost columns of the table aren't described in this topic. These columns display the     project's basic information—such as project manager, description, status, company, branch,     currency, and start and end dates. If you need information about these UI elements, see their     descriptions on the _Projects_ (PM301000) form. 

- The values are calculated **in the project currency**. The form shows values in the base currency     and the project currency if the _Multicurrency Accounting_ and _Multicurrency Projects_ features are     enabled on the _Enable/Disable Features_ (CS100000) form. 

 The table toolbar includes only standard buttons. For the list of standard buttons, see Table Toolbar. 

 Column Description 

 Revised Contract The revised budgeted amount of the project's revenue budget, which the system calculates as the sum of the Revised Budgeted Amount values specified on the Revenue Budget tab of the Projects (PM301000) form. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Revised Contract (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1208 

**Column Description** 

**Budgeted Cost** The revised budgeted amount of the project's cost budget, which the system calculates as the sum of the **Revised Budgeted Amount** values specified on the **Cost Budget** tab of the _Projects_ (PM301000) form. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Budgeted Cost (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**Gross Profit** The gross profit, which the system calculates by using this formula: Revised Contract Budgeted Cost. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Gross Profit (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**Margin (%)** The margin percentage, which the system calculates by using this formula: Gross Profit / Revised Contract. 

**Revenue to Date** The total amount of released project transactions with the _AR_ source and a date earlier than or the same as the date specified on the current form. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Revenue to Date (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**Expenses to Date** The total amount of released cost transactions with the date earlier than or the same as the date specified on the current form. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Expenses to Date (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**Completed (%)** The percent of project completion, which the system calculates by using this formula: Expenses to Date / Budgeted Cost. 

 If the budgeted cost is 0 , the Completed (%) will also be 0. 

**Gross Profit to Date** 

 The gross profit to date, which the system calculates by using this formula: Revenue to Date Expenses to Date. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Gross Profit to Date (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1209 

**Column Description** 

**Margin to Date (%)** The margin percentage as of a specified date, which the system calculates by using this formula: Gross Profit to Date / Revenue to Date. 

 If the Revenue to Date amount is 0 , the margin percentage will also be 0. 

**Open AR Amount** The open AR amount, which the system calculates by using this formula. 

 AR Amount (Project Curr.) AR Paid Amount (Project Curr.) AR Cash Discount (Project Curr.) Write-Off Amount (Project Curr.) Realized Gain/Loss (Project Curr.) 

 For a complete description of how the system calculates the values in this formula, refer to the Project AR Details (PM651002) form reference topic. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Open AR Amount (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**AR Retainage** The AR retainage amount, which the system calculates by using this formula. 

 AR Retained Amount (Project Curr.) + AR Retained Taxes (Project Curr.) 

 For a complete description of how the system calculates the values in this formula, refer to the Project AR Details (PM651002) form reference topic. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the AR Retainage (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**AR Difference** The AR difference amount, which the system calculates by using this formula: AR Cash Discount (Project Curr.) + Write-Of Amount (Project Curr.) + Realized Gain/Loss (Project Curr.). 

 For a complete description of how the system calculates the values in this formula, refer to the Project AR Details (PM651002) form reference topic. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the AR Difference (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1210 

**Column Description** 

**Taxes on Open AR** The tax amount from unpaid customer invoices for this project, which the system calculates by using this formula. 

 Inclusive Taxes on AR (Project Curr.) + Exclusive Taxes on AR (Project Curr.) Paid Inclusive Tax (Project Curr.) Exclusive Taxes on Paid AR (Project Curr.) 

 For a complete description of how the system calculates the values in this formula, refer to the Project AR Details (PM651002) form reference topic. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Taxes on Open AR (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**Open AP Amount** The open AP amount, which the system calculates by using this formula. 

 AP Amount (Project Curr.) AP Paid Amount (Project Curr.) AP Cash Discount (Project Curr.) Withheld Tax Amount (Project Curr.) Realized Gain/Loss (Project Curr.) 

 For a complete description of how the system calculates the values in this formula, refer to the Project AP Details (PM651001) form reference topic. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Open AP Amount (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**AP Retainage** The AP retainage amount, which the system calculates by using this formula: AP Retained Amount (Project Curr.) + AP Retained Taxes. 

 The values in the formula are from the Project AP Details (PM651001) form. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the AP Retainage (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**AP Difference** The AP difference amount, which the system calculates by using this formula. 

 AP Cash Discount (Project Curr.) + Withheld Tax Amount(Project Curr.) + Realized Gain/Loss (Project Curr.) 

 For a complete description of how the system calculates the values in this formula, refer to the Project AP Details (PM651001) form reference topic. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the AP Difference (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1211 

**Column Description** 

**Taxes on Open AP** The tax amount from unpaid vendor bills for this project, which the system calculates by using this formula. 

 Billed Inclusive Tax (Project Curr.) + Billed Tax (Project Curr.) 

- Paid Inclusive Tax (Project Curr.) - Exclusive Taxes on Paid AP (Project Curr.) 

 For a complete description of how the system calculates the values in this formula, refer to the Project AP Details (PM651001) form reference topic. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Taxes on Open AP (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

**Cash Inflow to Date** 

 The project's cash as of the specified date, which the system calculates by using this formula: Revenue to Date + Taxes on Open AR Amount Open AR Amount AR Retainage AR Difference. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Cash Inflow to Date (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

 The system calculates the project's cash inflow to date by using an indirect method. 

**Cash Outflow to Date** 

 The project's cash outflow as of the specified date, which the system calculates by using this formula: Expenses to Date Open AP Amount + Taxes on Open AP Amount AP Retainage AP Difference. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Cash Outflow to Date (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

 The system calculates the project's cash outflow to date by using an indirect method. 

**Cash Flow to Date** The project's cash flow as of the specified date, which the system calculates by using this formula: Cash Inflow to Date Cash Outflow to Date. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Cash Flow to Date (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly.

 Construction Forms | 1212 

 Column Description 

 Backlog Cash Inflow 

 The forecasted cash inflow as of the specified date, which the system calculates by using this formula: Revenue Budget Cash Inflow to Date. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Backlog Cash Inflow (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

 Backlog Cash Outflow 

 The forecasted cash outflow as of the specified date, which the system calculates by using this formula: Budgeted Cost Cash Outflow to Date. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Backlog Cash Outflow (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

 Backlog Cash Flow The forecasted cash flow as of the specified date, which the system calculates by using this formula: Backlog Cash Inflow Backlog Cash Outflow. 

 This value is calculated in the project currency. If multicurrency projects are set up in your system, you'll also see the Backlog Cash Flow (Base Curr.) column showing the value in the base currency. The system calculates it similarly. 

 Base Currency The base currency used for accounting in the current branch. 

 Currency Rate The exchange rate from the project currency to the base currency. 

 This rate is used to display amounts in the project and base currencies if the Multicurrency Accounting and Multicurrency Projects features are enabled on the Enable/Disable Features (CS100000) form. 

 Rate Variance for Cash Flow to Date (Base Curr.) 

 The rate variance for cash flow to date, which the system calculates by using this formula: Cash Flow to Date / Currency Rate Cash Flow to Date (Base Curr.). The rate variance is the accumulated difference between: 

- The cash flow converted from the project currency to the project’s base currency at     the current project rate 

- The cash flow converted at the historical rate of the project’s base currency

 Column Description 

 Total Billed Amount with Taxes 

 The total billed amount with taxes, which the system calculates by using this formula: Committed Billed Amount + Billed Exclusive Tax Amount + Billed Use Tax Amount. 

 Committed Amount to Bill 

 The amount of the commitments, which the system calculates by using this formula: Revised Committed Amount Committed Billed Amount. 

 Committed Quantity to Bill 

 The quantity of the commitments, which the system calculates by using this formula: Revised Committed Quantity Committed Billed Quantity. 

 Actual Non-Committed Amount 

 The amount of expenses that’s unrelated to commitments, which the system calculates by using this formula: Actual Amount Committed Billed Amount. 

 Actual Non-Committed Quantity 

 The quantity that’s unrelated to commitments, which the system calculates by using this formula: Actual Quantity Billed Quantity. 

 Committed Variance Amount 

 The variance amount, which the system calculates by using this formula: Revised Budgeted Amount Revised Committed Amount. 

 Committed Paid Amount 

 The sum of the paid amounts of bills for commitment lines with the project budget key specified in the line as of the specified Through Date. 

 Remaining Budgeted Amount to Date 

 The remaining budgeted amount to date, which the system calculates by using this formula: Revised Budgeted Amount Revised Committed Amount Actual Non-Committed Amount. 

 Amount-Based Budget Performance to Date (%) 

 The percentage of the revised budgeted amount that remains to date, which the system calculates by using this formula: (Remaining Budget Amount / Revised Budgeted Amount) * 100 %. 

## Project Financial Vision 

 Form ID: (PM405000) 

 This form is available only if the Construction feature is enabled on the Enable/Disable Features (CS100000) form. 

 On this form, you can analyze project expenses and revenues and investigate the financial performance of the project in the specified date range. The form shows aggregated project transactions broken down by the selected time period—year, quarter, month, or day—and grouped by the criteria that you specify in the Selection area. 

### Form Toolbar 

 The form toolbar includes standard and form-specific buttons and commands. For the list of standard buttons, see Form Toolbar and More Menu. The form-specific commands are listed in the following table. 

 Button Description 

 View Transactions Opens the Project Transaction Details (PM401000) form. This form shows the list of project transactions that correspond to the selected row. 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1221 

 Button Description 

 Zoom In Switches the period of data aggregation to shorter time period, refining the data scope in the table to a finer granularity. 

 Zoom Out Switches the period of data aggregation to a broader time period, expanding the data scope in the table to a higher-level view. 

 Show Chart Opens the Chart dialog box, which shows a graphical representation of the cumulative project costs or revenues over the date range being analyzed. 

### Selection Area 

 You can use the settings in this area to narrow the period for which the data is collected and define the grouping criteria for the gathered information. 

 Element Description 

 Project Required. The project for which you are analyzing revenues and expenses. 

 Account Groups The type of account groups whose project transactions are included in the aggregated view. Select one of the following options: Expense or Revenue. 

 Period The time period to be used for each row of aggregated data. The selected period determines the way data is broken down in the table. The following options are available: Year (default), Quarter , Month , and Day. 

 Start Date The date that starts the date range for which you want to view aggregated data. 

 End Date The date that ends the date range for which you want to view aggregated data. 

 Project Manager The project manager of the selected project. The system automatically populates the project manager specified in the project on the Projects (PM301000) form. 

 Project Task The project task for which you want to view aggregated data. You can select a specific task or leave the box empty to view a broader range of data. 

 Account Group The account group for which you want to view aggregated data. You can select a specific account group or leave the box empty to view a broader range of data. 

 Inventory ID The inventory item (or the empty item code) for which you want to view aggregated data. You can select a specific inventory ID, the empty item code, or leave the box empty to view a broader range of data. 

 The empty item code, which is N/A by default, is defined in the Empty Item Code box on the Projects Preferences (PM101000) form. 

 Cost Code The cost code for which you want to view aggregated data. You can select a specific cost code or leave the box empty to view a broader range of data. 

 This box is shown if the Cost Code feature is enabled on the Enable/Disable Features (CS100000) form. 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1222 

 Element Description 

 Group by Project Task 

 A check box that you select to show project task information in the table and group the project transactions with the same project task as a single row in the table. 

 Group by Account Group 

 A check box that you select to show account group information in the table and group the project transactions with the same account group as a single row in the table. 

 Group by Inventory ID 

 A check box that you select to show inventory item information in the table and group the project transactions with the same inventory item as a single row in the table. 

 Group by Cost Code 

 A check box that you select to show cost code information in the table and group the project transactions with the same cost code as a single row in the table. 

 Description The description of the selected project. The system automatically populates the description specified in the project on the Projects (PM301000) form. 

 Project Start The date when the project starts. The system automatically populates the start date specified in the project on the Projects (PM301000) form. 

 Project End The date when the project ends. The system automatically populates the end date specified in the project on the Projects (PM301000) form. 

 Total Actual Amount 

 The total actual amount of the project. If Expense is selected in the Account Groups box, this is the sum of the actual amounts of the cost budget lines of the project. If Revenue is selected in the Account Groups box, this is the sum of the actual amounts of the revenue budget lines of the project. 

 Total Budgeted Amount 

 The total budgeted amount of the project. If Expense is selected in the Account Groups box, this is the sum of the revised amounts of the cost budget lines of the project. If Revenue is selected in the Account Groups box, this is the sum of the revised amounts of the revenue budget lines of the project.

## Project Issue 

 Form ID: (PJ302000) 

 This form is available only if the Construction Project Management feature is enabled on the Enable/ Disable Features (CS100000) form. 

 You can use this form to create, view, and edit each project issue that has been discovered during a construction project. On this form, you track and report all activities related to the selected project issue. If needed, you can create a request for information or change request based on the selected issue. 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1224 

### Form Toolbar 

 The form toolbar includes standard buttons and form-specific buttons and commands. For the list of standard buttons, see Form Toolbar and More Menu. The form-specific commands can be shown as buttons on the form toolbar, as commands on the More menu, or in both places. These commands are listed in the following table in alphabetical order. 

 Command Description 

 Close Changes the status of the project issue to Closed. 

 This command appears if the project issue has the Open status. 

 Convert to Change Request 

 Creates a change request for the project issue, and navigates to the Change Requests (PM308500) form with the created change request; also, the status of the project issue changes to Converted to CR. 

 This command appears on the form if the Change Requests feature is enabled on the Enable/Disable Features (CS100000) form and the project issue has the Open status. 

 Convert to RFI Creates a request for information for the project issue, and navigates to the Request for Information (PJ301000) form with the created request for information. Also, when you click this command, the status of the project issue changes to Converted to RFI. 

 This command appears if the project issue has the Open status. 

 Print Opens the Project Issue Form (PJ662000), which displays a print-friendly version of the project issue that can be printed or sent by email. 

 Reopen Changes the status of the project issue to Open. 

 This command appears if the project issue has the Closed , Converted to CR , or Converted to RFI status. 

### Summary Area 

 In this area, you can specify the settings of a new project issue or select an existing project issue for modification. The following table summarizes the elements of this area. 

 Element Description 

 Summary A brief description of the issue that happened. 

 Project Issue ID The reference number of the project issue, which the system automatically assigns according to the numbering sequence selected for project issues on the Project Management Preferences (PJ101000) form. 

 Project The project related to the issue.

**Element Description** 

**Related Entity** The record or document related to the project issue. You assign the record or document by clicking the magnifier icon in this box, and selecting the type of the document or record and selecting the necessary document or record in the **Select Entity** dialog box. 

**Converted To** The reference number of the request for information or change request created for the project issue. The system fills in this box when the request for information or change request is saved. You can click the link to open the document on the related form. 

**Due Date** The date on which the project issue has to be resolved. 

**Priority** The priority of the project issue. The _Low_ , _Medium_ , and _High_ priorities are predefined in the system. By default, the system inserts the priority specified for the class of the project issue on the **Priorities** tab of the _Project Management Classes_ (PJ201000) form. 

**Status** The status of the project issue, which can be one of the following: 

- _Open_ : A new project issue has been created. 

- _Converted to RFI_ : A request for information has been created for the project issue.

- _Closed_ : The project issue has been closed.

 Element Description 

 Weather API Service 

 The weather service that is used for receiving information about weather conditions. The following options are available: 

- _OpenWeatherMap_ 

- _WeatherBit_ 

- _AccuWeather_ 

 Weather API Key The key that is used for the weather service. 

 UOM Format The UOM format to be used to display numerical values of weather conditions, which is one of the following options: 

- _Metric_ : Temperature is measured in degrees Celsius, wind velocity is measured in me-     ters per second, and precipitation is measured in millimeters. 

- _Imperial_ (default): Temperature is measured in degrees Fahrenheit, wind velocity is     measured in miles per hour, and precipitation is measured in inches. 

 Request By The location type to be used for the call to an API of a weather condition service.

- _ZIP Code and Country_ 

- _City and Country_ 

- _Geographic Location_ If the _AccuWeather_ weather service is selected, only the _Geographic Location_ option is available. 

 This box is available only if the weather service is selected in the Weather API Service box. 

 Test Connection A button you can click to send a request to the weather service to test the connection. 

 Enable Weather Processing Log 

 A check box that indicates (if selected) that the functionality of monitoring API calls to a weather service is enabled. 

 Weather Processing Log Term (Days) 

 The number of days the system should keep the recent history of requests and responses to and from the weather service. 

 This box is available only if the Enable Weather Processing Log check box is selected.

## Project Profitability 

 Form ID: (PM658100) 

 This generic inquiry form is available if the Extended Financial Data Collection feature is enabled on the Enable/Disable Features (CS100000) form. 

 You can use this form to view project profitability as of the date you specify. 

### Form Toolbar 

 The form toolbar includes only standard buttons. For the list of standard buttons, see Form Toolbar and More Menu. 

### Selection Area 

 In this area, you can select the project whose data you want to view in the table and the date through which profitability data will be calculated. 

 Element Description 

 Through Date The date as of which data is displayed. By default, the system inserts the current business date. 

 Project The project for which you want to view profitability information. By default, this box is empty. 

### Table 

 If no project is selected, the table lists all projects with the Active or Completed status, but you can select a specific project to see only its data. Each row represents a project. 

 The lemost columns of the table aren't described in this topic. These columns display the project's basic information—such as project identifier, description, owner, start and end dates, and status. If you need information about these UI elements, see their descriptions on the Projects (PM301000) form. 

 The table toolbar includes only standard buttons. For the list of standard buttons, see Table Toolbar. 

 Table: Table Columns 

 Column Description 

 Original Contract The original budgeted amount of the revenue budget lines of the project, which the system calculates by adding all the Original Budgeted Amount values. 

 Original Budget The original budgeted amount of the cost budget lines of the project, which the system calculates by adding all the Original Budgeted Amount values. 

 Original Profit The expected profit amount, which the system calculates based on the originally budgeted amounts by subtracting the Original Budget amount from the Original Contract amount. 


<!-- PAGE_BREAK -->
 Construction Forms | 1245 

 Column Description 

 Original Margin (%) 

 The expected margin percentage, which the system calculates based on the originally budgeted amounts by using this formula: (Original Profit / Original Contract) * 100%. 

 If the Original Contract amount is 0 , the Original Margin (%) is le empty. 

 Revised Contract The revised budgeted amount for the revenue budget lines of the project, which the system calculates by adding all the Revised Budgeted Amount values. 

 Revised Budget The revised budgeted amount for the cost budget lines of the project, which the system calculates by adding all the Revised Budgeted Amount values. 

 Revised Profit The revised profit amount, which the system calculates by subtracting the Revised Budget amount from the Revised Contract amount. 

 Revised Margin (%) The margin percentage calculated based on the revised budget amounts, which the system calculates by using this formula: (Revised Profit / Revised Contract) * 100. 

 Billed Amount to Date 

 The accumulated revenue amount up to the Through Date , which the system calculates by adding the Amount values. 

 These Amount values the amounts of the project transactions with the AR source on the Project Transactions (PM304000) form. 

 The project transactions that originate from AR invoices and debit memos increase the calculated amount; the project transactions that originate from AR credit memos decrease the calculated amount. 

 Actual Costs to Date 

 The cost amount accumulated up to the Through Date , which the system calculates by summing the Amount values. These Amount values are the amounts of the expense project transactions on the Project Transactions (PM304000) form. 

 Profit to Date The profit amount to date, which the system calculates by using this formula: Billed Amount to Date Actual Costs to Date. 

 Margin to Date (%) The margin percentage to date, which the system calculates by using this formula: (Profit to Date/Actual Costs to Date) * 100%.
